~ do you want coffee?
Marian(F): .ie ki'e
~ yes, thanks

title: lo taxfu
script:
# lo taxfu
F: coi .i mi djica le vi xunre taxfu
~ Hi, I want this red coat
M: .i lo taxfu cu se jdima li mu
~ It costs five
F: .i ti banli .i mi te vecnu lo taxfu
~ great, I'll buy it
M: ki'e
~ thanks
F: je'e
~ you're welcome
---
? fill: M: .i lo taxfu cu se [jdima] li mu
? bank: F: coi .i mi djica le vi [xunre] taxfu (chips: blanu, crino)
translation: Buying a coat. A woman wants a red coat; the stated price is five.
notes: Idea from duostories 'la chaqueta roja'. `se jdima` places the item before the price; `li mu` gives a bare number without specifying a currency. `je'e` is a pragmatic response to `ki'e`.
